purpose: Teach: ズーム/ベンツ/ルネッサンス/洋画/マンチェスター/ジャンボ/アドリブ/コナン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカメラのズーム機能を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed me the camera's zoom function.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Soft opening. Speaking as though sharing a small, genuine moment. Slightly dreamy cadence — noticing the small care in these moments. No performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがベンツに乗せて下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad let me ride in his car.
lines.style: Bright, unguarded excitement. Quick opening attack. Words tumble out with genuine pride. Eager to share. Childlike directness — no filtering, just joy. Small pause after 'car' like he's waiting for her reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがルネッサンスの絵本を読んで下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad read me a picture book about the Renaissance.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wondering tone. Speaks slowly, as if touched by the detail of it. Each phrase lands softly. The kind of voice that notices when someone takes time for you. Trailing slightly on 'Renaissance.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと洋画のアニメ観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched a Western anime together.
lines.style: Bright, energetic delivery. Opens with certainty and warmth. The rhythm accelerates slightly — he's eager to match her with his own story. Small voice still, but confident. Punctuates on 'together' like that was the best part.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマンチェスターのチームを応援されるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad supports a Manchester football team.
lines.style: Quietly amused observation. Gentle tempo. Sounds like she's noting something endearing about him — a detail that charmed her. Slight lift of warmth in 'supports,' like she finds it sweet. No judgment, just noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ジャンボサイズのアイス食べたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to eat a jumbo-sized ice cream.
lines.style: Sudden shift to pure childish want. Direct, unfiltered, almost breathless. Opens with longing. The phrasing is simple and honest — no diplomacy. A small-voice request with full conviction behind it. Brief and earnest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが歌のアドリブを楽しまれてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was really enjoying improvising with song.
lines.style: Soft, fond recollection. Unhurried pace. Opens gently and settles into the memory of watching him. Warmth threaded through — she's noticing his joy. Slight trailing on the final phrase, lingering on the image of him happy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとコナンの新刊読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read the new Conan book together.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied close. Opens with quiet pride. Slightly slower than his earlier lines — he's savoring this one, the special closeness of it. Settles into the moment. Ends with gentle finality, like he's sharing something precious and knows she'll understand.
